summary: activities list --all and the MCP activities.list endpoint page GET /activities by page number, like activities sync.
reason: GET /activities returns PaginationMeta (page, per_page, total, has_more) with no next cursor. The generator gave activities list --all and the MCP activities.list page config a cursor setting, so --all stopped after page one and an MCP agent following cursor_param sent cursor=, which the endpoint ignores, and re-read page one (Greptile PR #2450 thread 4514458610, P1).
validated_outcome: TestNovel1219ActivitiesListAllWalksEveryNumberedPage (CLI --all walks a two-page fixture: page one then page=2, three rows) and TestNovel1219MCPActivitiesListWalksEveryNumberedPage (an MCP agent following cursor_param reads both pages); both fail on the cursor setting.
